erik.profile: Erik — a slick Russian car flipper in his 30s pretending to be a private owner, too sweet and smooth, in sunglasses.
erik.notes: Line 1: smooth, reassuring, a bit too sweet. Line 2: careless slip of the tongue, fast — he lists colors because he has several cars, then realizes. Line 3: the same slip again, slower and clearly, like a replay. Line 4: dismissive, pushy, fake-friendly «Брат».

lis.profile: Lis — a cool, deadpan, ironic street narrator of an adult comedy show about used-car flippers. Low calm voice, dry humor, confident.
lis.notes: Standalone episode of the rubric «Схемы»: a car flipper pretends to be the owner. Deadpan, dry irony. «ПТС» is said «пэ-тэ-эс». «Перехват» is the name of a bot. Line «Стоп. Перемотаем.» — sudden, playful, like pressing pause.
